subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Aristocret"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Aristocrats **are people from **high social standing families**, especially those who have titles.
 
• According to **English grammar**, **Aristocrat** is the correct word.
 
• Therefore, **"Aristocret"** is not a correctly spelt word.
